forum.title: Is the flash memory contious in the 256kB STM32C552VC
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

They are not contiguous in 256K devices:

Bank1 finishes at 0x0801FFFF, Bank 2 starts at 0x08040000
forum.content_text: As asked in the subject: Is there a hole in the memory map of the STM32C552VC (Bank1 from 0x08000000 to 0x08020000 / Bank2 from 0x08040000 to 0x08060000) or are the two banks continuous from 0x08000000 to 0x08040000)
